new_jobs.description:
Overview

Since our founding in 1924, we've cut cardiovascular disease deaths in half, but there is still so much more to do. To overcome today’s biggest health challenges and accelerate this progress, we need passionate individuals like you. Join our movement, be part of the progress, and help ensure a healthier future for all. You matter, and so does the impact you can make with us.

The Association offers many resources to help you maintain work-life harmonization through your changing needs and life situations. To help you be successful, you will have access to Heart U, our award-winning corporate university, as well as additional training and support, locally.

\#TheAHALife is more than a company culture; it is our way of life. It embodies our commitment to work-life harmonization and is guided by our core values where our employees can thrive both personally and professionally. Discover why you will Be Seen. Be Heard. Be Valued at the American Heart Association by following us on LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X, and at heart.jobs.

The American Heart Association has an excellent opportunity for a Program Manager, AI, Partnerships & Product Solutions for Sustainable Food Systems.

This position can be home-based within the U.S.

Background

Sustainable Food Systems @ Heart is an innovation portfolio of the American Heart Association focused on transforming food systems into measurable drivers of human and planetary health. Within Sustainable Food Systems @ Heart, The Periodic Table of Food Initiative (PTFI)® serves to build the scientific infrastructure to move food to a health solution.

Specifically, The Periodic Table of Food Initiative (PTFI)® is a science-to-action effort of the Rockefeller Foundation that is managed by the American Heart Association. The PTFI offers standardized multi-omics tools, data, and training to a global ecosystem to characterize food quality and biomarkers of consumption and health. Our global ecosystem is mapping food quality based on diverse components, including macronutrients, micronutrients, and specialized metabolites, as well as their variation across food systems. PTFI’s vision is a world where stakeholders in food, agriculture and health are enabled to lead data-driven solutions that provide healthy food from sustainable food systems. https://foodperiodictable.org

Responsibilities

The Program Manager, AI, Partnerships & Product Solutions advances the translation and growth of Sustainable Food Systems @ Heart and the Periodic Table of Food Initiative (PTFI)® by developing opportunities that connect scientific capabilities, data, and innovation with funding, partnerships, practical applications, and business opportunities. Reporting to the Senior Lead for Product Innovation and Engagement, this role helps move strategic opportunities from concept toward implementation by securing resources, engaging external partners, and supporting the development of products and solutions with potential for impact, scale, and revenue generation.

The Program Manager works across internal teams and external collaborators to identify and develop opportunities that advance the application of PTFI science and data across food, nutrition, and health. The role contributes to fundraising and revenue development through grant proposals, corporate engagement, and other strategic partnerships, while also supporting product development within the American Heart Association and with external partners. This includes assessing opportunities, developing proposals and concepts, coordinating cross-functional activities, and helping translate scientific and stakeholder needs into actionable product and partnership strategies.

Data and artificial intelligence are central to the translation strategy of Sustainable Food Systems @ Heart and PTFI, enabling scientific knowledge and data to be transformed into actionable products, tools, and solutions for food and health. The Program Manager brings strong knowledge of AI and emerging technologies to support development of these applications, working cross-functionally with the PTFI team and across scientific, technical, product, and business teams to identify opportunities, translate needs into product requirements, coordinate expertise, and support the responsible and effective use of data and AI.

The Program Manager serves as a cross-functional connector across Sustainable Food Systems @ Heart, the PTFI, and external partners, helping align resources, relationships, scientific and technological assets, and business strategy to advance innovative solutions for food and health.

Responsibilities

Funding, Revenue & Strategic Partnerships

Identify and develop funding and revenue opportunities aligned with Sustainable Food Systems @ Heart priorities.
Develop grant proposals, concept notes, presentations, and other materials for philanthropic, corporate, and other prospective funders and partners.
Support cultivation and engagement of corporate and other strategic partners to advance funding, collaboration, and product opportunities.
Assess prospective opportunities for alignment with scientific priorities, organizational capabilities, impact, and potential for sustainability and scale.
Coordinate cross-functional input into proposals and partnership opportunities, including development of scopes, budgets, deliverables, and supporting materials.
Contribute to development of new approaches for generating sustainable funding and revenue from PTFI science, data, products, and capabilities.
Support partner stewardship, reporting, and communications for funded initiatives and strategic collaborations.

Product Development & Translation

Support development of products, tools, and solutions that translate PTFI science, data, and Sustainable Food Systems @ Heart capabilities into practical applications across food, nutrition, and health.
Work cross-functionally with the PTFI team and other internal stakeholders to identify and assess opportunities for new products and applications.
Support product development from early concept through implementation, including development of use cases, requirements, workplans, and pathways to scale and monetization.
Translate scientific capabilities, stakeholder needs, and market opportunities into actionable product concepts and development requirements.
Coordinate internal and external contributors supporting product development, including scientific, technical, product, business, and other subject matter experts.
Support products developed internally by the American Heart Association as well as those advanced in collaboration with external partners.
Contribute to assessment and development of business models, monetization pathways, partnerships, funding approaches, and go-to-market strategies that support adoption, financial sustainability, and scale of emerging products and solutions.

AI & Data-Enabled Innovation

Support development and application of AI- and data-enabled products, tools, and solutions that advance Sustainable Food Systems @ Heart and PTFI translation priorities.
Identify opportunities to leverage PTFI and complementary data to address needs across food, nutrition, and health.
Translate scientific, product, and stakeholder needs into clear use cases and requirements for data scientists, engineers, technology partners, and product developers.
Coordinate with scientific teams, AI experts, technology teams, and external partners to support development and implementation of data- and AI-enabled applications.
Support integration and appropriate use of diverse datasets within emerging products and applications.
Work with relevant subject matter experts to support responsible data and AI practices, including data provenance, permissions, governance, licensing, privacy, and appropriate use.
Monitor emerging AI technologies and applications relevant to food and health and identify opportunities to strengthen PTFI-enabled products and translation activities.

Qualifications

Education

Bachelor's degree in business, public health, nutrition, food science, life sciences, data science, technology, innovation, or related field required.
Master's degree or other relevant advanced degree strongly preferred.

Professional Experience

Minimum three (3) years of experience in program management, product development, strategic partnerships, business development, fundraising, innovation, or a related field. Five (5)+ years of experience preferred.
Experience developing successful grant proposals, funding opportunities, and/or strategic partnerships.
Experience supporting product development from concept through implementation in a scientific, technology, healthcare, or other innovation-driven environment.
Demonstrated ability to translate complex scientific, technical, or programmatic information into clear proposals, plans, and opportunities for multiple audiences.
Experience working across scientific, technical, product, business, and/or external partner teams.
Experience in food and nutrition, healthcare, life sciences, food systems, technology, or another science-driven field strongly preferred.
Experience with business strategy, corporate partnerships, revenue-generating initiatives, business model development, commercialization, or development of monetization strategies strongly preferred.

Technical Competencies

Strong grant and proposal development skills, including the ability to translate scientific, programmatic, and product concepts into compelling narratives for multiple funding audiences.
Ability to identify and assess philanthropic, corporate, government, and other funding opportunities for alignment with organizational priorities and program needs.
Ability to effectively communicate and collaborate with scientific, technical, product, and business stakeholders.
Ability to translate scientific and data capabilities into product concepts and requirements, working across scientific, technical, and business teams to support development from early concept through implementation and scale.
Strong working knowledge of artificial intelligence, data science, and emerging technologies and their application to products and decision-support tools.
Ability to develop business and product strategy, including market and customer discovery, value proposition development, business models, monetization approaches, and strategies for product adoption and sustainable growth.

Leadership & Systems Skills

Strong analytical and systems-oriented thinker.
Ability to translate scientific and technical capabilities into actionable product, partnership, and funding opportunities.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Proven ability to collaborate across interdisciplinary teams.
Comfortable operating in a fast-growing, mission-driven environment.

Compensation & Benefits

new_jobs.description:
The Pediatric Epilepsies & Rare CNS (PERC) Gene Editing Platform is the Center for Therapeutic Genetics (CTG) project funded by ARPA-H’s THRIVE program. PERC aims to develop and clinically deploy platformized delivery of precision gene editors to treat children with developmental and epileptic encephalopathies (DEEs), including Alternating Hemiplegia of Childhood and Dravet syndrome.

CTG at the Broad Institute serves as the coordinator hub for PERC, responsible for program leadership, regulatory strategy, centralized data management, IP stewardship, and other key administrative and operational tasks. The program spans IND-enabling nonclinical studies, CMC development with CDMO partners, clinical trial execution, and regulatory strategy targeting first-in-human dosing in less than 2 years.

The ARPA-H THRIVE PERC Project Manager will own end-to-end operational coordination across a complex, multi-institutional team that includes the Broad Institute, the Jackson Laboratory, Boston Children’s Hospital, Children’s Hospital of Colorado, various patient advocacy organizations, and several biotech and industry partners. The PM will be responsible for ensuring program advancement on timeline against ARPA-H’s defined objectives, metrics, and module payment milestones, and will serve as the operation backbone connecting nonclinical, CMC, clinical, and regulatory workstreams.

This position reports to the PERC Program Director (Winston Yan, CTG Senior Director) and works in close coordination with the Center for Therapeutic Genetics Leadership and the PERC scientific and clinical teams. The role is based in Cambridge, MA, allowing for occasional remote work.

Responsibilities

Project Management & Coordination

In addition to the PERC Program Director, serve as the primary point of contact between the PERC team and the ARPA-H THRIVE Program Manager, Contracts Officer, and associated government personnel.
Maintain and manage the integrated program Gantt charge across all modules (Mod. 1 nonclinical D&D, Mod. 2 investigational medicine, Mod. 3 pilot and scale), ensuring cross-workstream dependencies are tracked and risks are surfaced early.
Convene and facilitate regular internal team meetings across Broad, clinical sites, CDMOs, and patient organization partners; prepare agendas, drive decisions, and track action items to closure.
Coordinate data sharing, technology transfer, and communication protocols among all team members per THRIVE’s Performer Agreement requirements.
Organize and manage all ARPA-H required reporting, including monthly technical and financial status reports, quarterly reviews, and end-of-module reports; ensure submissions are on time, accurate, and tell a coherent narrative of progress.

Milestone & Budget Oversight

Track progress against THRIVE’s defined milestones, metrics, and point system across all modules, and flagging payment risks in advance
Provide monthly financial reports and other requested materials to ARPA-H contract and program officers as requested.
Partner with sponsored research teams at the Broad and PERC partner institutions to manage the program budget, monitor burn rate against the milestone payment schedule, and support cost-share tracking.
Coordinate vendor and CDMO deliverables and nonclinical study timelines against the critical path to IND.

Regulatory & Compliance Coordination

Support regulatory strategy efforts in coordinating regulatory submissions and meeting logistics, including INTERACT, pre-IND, IND, and any parallel FDA interactions.
Ensure that all regulatory correspondence and public disclosure deliverables are documented, tracked, and submitted within required timeframes based on receipt of regulatory feedback.
Coordinate IBC, IACUC, IRB, and any other assurance documentation across performing institutions, ensuring that all approvals are in place before relevant costs are incurred.
Support preparation for and attendance at THRIVE regulatory roundtables (twice yearly) and monthly regulatory affairs meetings with the ARPA-H team.

Stakeholder & Partner Management

new_jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Software Systems
new_jobs.description:
Help drive the execution of MatrixSpace’s AI-enabled radar systems by turning complex, cross-functional software priorities into clear plans that teams can deliver against.

MatrixSpace develops AI-enabled radar and sensing systems that help people understand what's happening in the world around them. By combining advanced radar, edge computing, and AI, we deliver situational awareness in environments where traditional sensing solutions struggle.

We're looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager, Software Systems to own planning and execution across our software organization. You'll bring together platform development, AI/ML, DevSecOps, UI/UX, systems integration, product commitments, and customer programs into a coordinated execution plan, working across engineering, product, program, test, and operations. This is a senior individual-contributor role where you'll create clarity, surface conflicts early, and drive execution through influence rather than direct authority.

If you're technically fluent, comfortable challenging assumptions, and skilled at creating clarity across teams with competing priorities, we'd love to talk.

What You'll Do

Own and maintain the integrated software execution plan across Software Systems, translating approved priorities into coordinated schedules, dependencies, releases, milestones, readiness criteria, and escalation paths.
Bring product, customer, and program commitments into a common plan for shared software resources, working with Product and Program Management to identify competing demands and resolve priority conflicts before they disrupt execution.
Lead cross-functional execution across Core Software, AI/Data Science, DevSecOps, UI/UX, Mission Systems, Test Engineering, Product Management, Program Management, and Operations.
Partner with technical leaders to turn priorities into actionable work plans, backlogs, sprint plans, release plans, and measurable milestones while leaving architecture and technical decisions with the appropriate engineering owners.
Establish and run an effective software planning and execution cadence, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, release planning, retrospectives, and readiness reviews, using enough process to create predictability without adding unnecessary overhead.
Identify cross-team dependencies, resource constraints, schedule risks, and unrealistic commitments early. Bring stakeholders together around the issue, recommend practical tradeoffs, and escalate when a decision is needed.
Give senior leaders a clear view of execution, risks, dependencies, and decisions while continuously improving the planning mechanisms that help teams work effectively across organizational boundaries.

What We're Looking For

This position requires working directly or indirectly with the US Government in restricted environments. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States without employer sponsorship and may be required to obtain and maintain a U.S. government security clearance in the future.

Required

8+ years of experience leading complex software development programs, technical programs, or cross-functional engineering initiatives in technically demanding product environments.
A track record of owning execution across multiple engineering disciplines, products, or programs where teams share resources and priorities compete.
Technical fluency across modern software development environments, including meaningful experience working with software engineering, AI/ML, DevSecOps, and systems integration teams.
Experience translating complex technical and business priorities into executable plans, dependencies, milestones, release schedules, and readiness criteria.
Strong working knowledge of Agile software development practices and hands-on experience with development planning and execution tools such as Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, GitHub Projects, or similar platforms.
Demonstrated ability to influence experienced technical and business leaders without direct authority, including challenging unrealistic timelines, surfacing conflicts, and holding stakeholders accountable to agreed plans.
The judgment and communication skills to frame execution problems in terms of their broader system and organizational impact, present clear options and tradeoffs, and build alignment among teams with different priorities.

Someone Who Will Thrive in This Role

You create clarity when priorities, dependencies, and ownership are complicated or changing.
You're comfortable holding your ground with experienced, opinionated stakeholders and can push back constructively when plans or commitments aren't realistic.
You stay several steps ahead, recognizing how a decision or delay in one part of the software organization will affect teams elsewhere.
You build credibility with technical teams through curiosity, preparation, follow-through, and an understanding of where program leadership ends and technical leadership begins.
You care about making teams more effective, not about adding process for its own sake, and continuously look for simpler ways to make execution more visible and predictable.

Bonus Points

Experience supporting defense, aerospace, government, or other mission-critical programs.
Experience coordinating software delivery for products that combine software with hardware, sensors, edge computing, or other complex physical systems.
Experience supporting customer deployments, formal readiness gates, or releases with significant integration and test requirements.
Familiarity with radar, sensing, autonomy, or other real-world AI-enabled systems.

At MatrixSpace, this role sits at the center of how shared software capabilities move from development into products and customer programs. You'll help technical and business leaders turn complex priorities into coordinated execution so our teams can deliver capable, reliable systems in the real world. If that sounds exciting, we'd love to hear from you.

A Project Manager, Level III is responsible for managing multiple assigned mid-sized to large projects within Edmund Optics. Project Manager, Level III develop and manage all aspects of project engagement as well as monitor, track, and adjust outcomes to ensure those projects are proceeding as planned . Monitor, track, and adjust outcomes to resolve issues, conflicts, dependencies, and critical path deliverables

new_jobs.title: Program Manager- Hypersonic Vehicle
new_jobs.description:
Stratolaunch is a technology accelerator that engineers operationally realistic testing at Mach 5+. Our air-launched, Talon testbeds are reusable, cost-effective platforms that enable routine access to the hypersonic environment. We deliver flight data critical to validating system performance and achieving rapid technology deployment. Together with our customers, we drive innovations that are imperative to advancing national security.

Stratolaunch seeks a Program Manager to deliver reliable and successful launch platform projects and flight-ready aircraft capability to our customers. In this role, you will be responsible for meeting schedule, cost, and technical objectives for all launch platform service-center related work. Candidates must have a strong sense of urgency, be dedicated to delivering to our customers, and be motivated to drive cross-functional teams to successfully operate our launch platforms. This role requires creative problem solving to significantly increase hypersonic test cadence while also driving affordability into mission operations. This role will require you to roll up your sleeves and work with a multi-faceted team to deliver for customers in a challenging operational environment.

You will work for the Stratolaunch Program Management department. In this role, you will own the integration of all Stratolaunch launch platform service-center projects. Launch platforms are both certified and experimental aircraft. You will own the cost, schedule, and technical integration of all launch platform activities. This includes managing schedules, planning cross-functional resources and staffing, creating budgets and forecasts, mitigating risks experienced in flight test, and delivering aircraft ready to achieve all test objectives. An optimal candidate will have a strong operational background in flight test execution, with experience modifying and integrating new technologies onto launch platforms. You will be responsible for drastically increasing our launch platform flight cadence, while also driving reliability and affordability initiatives into all launch platform projects. This role requires supporting flight test at all hours of the day and some travel to support global operations. You will work with the Stratolaunch finance and accounting office, operations team, and engineering team.

Essential Responsibilities

Lead the execution and integration of all launch platform service-center projects, delivering on-schedule, on-budget, and with completion of all project objectives.
Own launch platform risks. Mitigate the flight test risks and drive issues to closure with timely actions to ensure positive results are delivered to our customers.
Lead the service-center integration of one-off aircraft modification and aircraft maintenance projects.
Develop schedules and resource plans to complete all elements of launch platform execution.
Track maintenance and special-project costs over time and analyze variances. Accountable for achieving the launch platform budgets.
Support and plan for all variable flight costs, including fuel, maintenance, flight crew proficiency flights, etc.
Drive affordability and efficiency into launch platform execution to increase mission profitability.
Lead Program Reviews for all launch platforms.
Serve as a program representative in internal and customer-facing meetings, as required.
Work with Finance and company leadership to ensure planning and financial tracking processes and procedures meet US Government contracting requirements.
Develop and drive critical program management launch platform metrics for the program.
Coordinate and help resolve program financial challenges, as required.
Support the preparation of business proposals to the US Government and industry.
Travel, as required, to support launch platform execution.
Demonstrate honesty, responsibility, integrity, and fulfillment of commitments.

Qualifications

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Required

Knowledge of, and experience with, both certified and experimental heavy aircraft.
Knowledge of, and experience with, one or more of these disciplines: Flight and/or launch vehicle testing, aircraft maintenance, heavy aircraft integration and testing, flight test scheduling and cost tracking.
Experience leading and working with engineers, technicians, testers, and customers to deliver flight-ready aircraft.
Experience developing schedules and managing teams who are motivated to achieve challenging test goals.
Experience with program financial analysis, including variance analysis and developing forecasts.
Experience with driving risk and issues to closure in a timely manner.
Ability to develop and analyze data, and present findings to customers and management.
Strong analytical problem-solving skills and ability to implement sound critical thinking skills.
Ability to work on their own initiative and prioritize tasking to fit within the business goals.
Ability to work under tight deadlines, managing multiple priorities in a dynamic and changing environment.
Ability to obtain a Top Secret security clearance.

Education & Experience

Staff-level ($122,000-$144,300): Bachelor’s degree (B.A. or B.S.) or higher and 8-12 years relevant program management experience or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Principal-level ($149,500-$177,000): Bachelor’s degree (B.A. or B.S.) or higher and 12+ years relevant program management experience or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Sr. Principal-level ($174,500-$214,000): Bachelor’s degree (B.A. or B.S.) or higher and 15+ years relevant program management experience or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Special remarks regarding work environment, if applicable

Supporting flight test often means contributing during off-nominal hours and weekends.
All candidates are expected to be onsite in Mojave >= 80% of normal work days.
Travel estimated to be approximately 10% or less.
This position is located in Mojave, CA.

Benefits and our location:

Relocation eligible to local area – Mojave, CA
9/80 schedule

Base salary and leveling are established on a case-by-case basis. We consider several factors to ensure a competitive offer, including your location, educational background, and a comprehensive assessment of the skills and experience demonstrated during your interviews.

Benefits and our location(s)
:

Healthcare (medical, dental, vision, prescription drugs)
Paid Maternity and Parental Leave
50% company match per contributed dollar into 401(k) savings plan, up to $11,500
Tuition reimbursement

This position may involve the operation of company vehicles as part of assigned duties.

Mojave Air & Spaceport is located just outside of Lancaster/Palmdale and is only 95 miles north of Los Angeles. The area offers both affordability and central access to a variety of California's best attractions and landmarks.

Not much for the outdoors and prefer the city life? You’re within a half day’s drive or less of Los Angeles, San Diego, Las Vegas, and San Francisco where you can find a variety of live entertainment, museums, tours, and historical sight-seeing. Theme parks are in abundance, with Six Flags Magic Mountain, Disneyland, and Knotts Berry Farm ready to meet the needs of rollercoaster thrill seekers.

Food and drink fanatics are in a haven of delectable choices. Wine aficionados will also find easy access to some of the state’s best vino in Paso Robles, Santa Ynez, and even more locally in Tehachapi and Agua Dulce. Beer fanatics will find some of the best West Coast IPAs at Bravery and Lucky Luke’s in Lancaster. Any food option you crave is covered, and we always recommend the authentic and fresh Mexican food that you won’t find anywhere else in the United States.

new_jobs.title: IT Security Manager - Third-Party IT Risk Manager
new_jobs.description:
Third‑Party IT Risk Manager
is responsible for leading and modernizing Wolters Kluwer’s global third‑party cyber risk management capability across a highly distributed, market‑driven technology and supplier landscape. This role ensures third-party engagements align with the organization’s risk appetite, security standards, and regulatory expectations and lead the execution of a scalable, intelligence‑led TPRM program that delivers meaningful and defensible assurance over third‑party cyber risk—moving beyond traditional, questionnaire‑centric models.

The role partners closely with Global Supply Chain, Procurement, Legal, and Privacy teams to reduce fragmentation across markets by translating diverse, market‑specific approaches into standardized enterprise agreements, security configurations, and control expectations. A core focus of this position is innovation: designing and implementing differentiated third‑party assurance approaches that leverage automation, technical validation, and continuous monitoring to provide real‑time insight into supplier risk rather than relying solely on static assessments.

Responsibilities:

Program Leadership & Modernization

Lead and evolve Wolters Kluwer’s global Third Party Risk Management (TPRM) program and operating model, ensuring it is scalable, risk based, and aligned with enterprise cyber risk governance.
Modernize TPITRM by shifting from a primarily questionnaire driven approach to a data driven program that incorporates technical validation, continuous monitoring, AI, and risk quantification.
Lead, whether functionally or formally – junior team members as a manager level leader across the TPRM function to drive successful outcomes across the entire TPRM unit.

Continuous Monitoring, Automation & Innovation

Implement continuous monitoring capabilities to deliver near real time visibility into third party cyber posture, control performance, and emerging risk indicators.
Design and deploy innovative approaches—including automation and AI assisted techniques—for evidence collection, risk scoring, and exception management.
Continuously assess emerging tools, data sources, and assurance models to improve risk coverage, reduce assessment friction, and enhance signal quality beyond traditional questionnaires.

Contract Review:

Strong skills in the development, review, and analysis of third party contracts to ensure Company requirements, principles, and assets are sufficiently protected in accordance with internal expectations.
Strong business acumen and ability to identify technical and functional requirements that do not align or meet Company needs, suggest enhancements, and have them accepted and implemented by the supplier.

Governance, Reporting & Escalation

Maintain a centralized, enterprise wide inventory of third party relationships, risk tiers, and risk treatment decisions.
Provide clear, concise reporting on third party cyber risk posture, trends, and concentration risk to senior leadership.

Leadership & Collaboration

Build, lead, and develop a high performing team of third party risk professionals and technical reviewers.
Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, and constructive challenge consistent with Wolters Kluwer values and operating principles.

Job Qualifications

Bachelors degree in computer science, information security, management information systems or similar.
12+ years of experience in cybersecurity, technology risk, or information security, including significant ownership of third party or supplier cyber risk management in large, complex enterprises.
5+ years of leadership (direct managerial experience or functional delivery leading teams).
Proven experience designing and leading a global TPRM program across the full third party risk lifecycle.
Demonstrated success modernizing TPRM by implementing risk based approaches that integrate technical validation, automation, and continuous monitoring.
Demonstrated success owning decisions and outcomes at a senior level independently without formal authority.
Strong technical fluency across cloud platforms, APIs, identity, data flows, and integration architectures, with the ability to partner credibly with security architects and technical SMEs.
Experience overseeing advanced technical assessments for high risk or critical third parties, such as architecture reviews, vulnerability assessments, penetration testing, and threat modeling.
Ability to operate effectively in highly distributed, market driven environments.
Demonstrated leadership experience, including building high performing teams and influencing senior stakeholders across Technology, Procurement, Legal, Privacy, and Enterprise Risk Management.
Strong executive communication skills, with experience reporting third party cyber risk posture and trends to senior leadership.

Preferred Qualification

Familiarity with systemic, concentration, and fourth‑party risk.
Working knowledge of NIST CSF, ISO 27001, GDPR, and CCPA.
Relevant certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISM, CTPRP, CRISC, CISA)

Kastle is a leader in premier property technology solutions, protecting everything from commercial real estate and global enterprises to critical government facilities and life-science labs. As the Pre-Sales Program Manager,
you are the single point of accountability for Kastle’s most complex Regional and National accounts. You will own the entire presales cycle from initial qualification through client acceptance. While you will not be doing technical design, you will act as a project leader uniting sales, engineering, subcontractors, and operations into a cohesive winning strategy. You will ensure every proposal is backed by a defined scope, schedule, and smooth operational handoff. To thrive here, you need strong program management experience and the executive presence to engage directly with ownership groups, developers, and enterprise clients.

Our success is driven by the combination of advanced technology and talented people. We are proud to be a Certified Great Place to Work®, recognized for a culture that prioritizes both professional excellence and employee well-being. In addition to a great work environment, we provide a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) plan, and generous paid time off. Our offerings also include tuition and training assistance, BrightHorizons lifestyle assistance, life and disability insurance, and wellness programs. For more information on what it's like to work with us, please visit Life at Kastle.

Responsibilities

Strategic Pursuit Leadership

Serve as the overall pre-sales team leader for all Regional and National strategic account opportunities, coordinating the activities of sales engineers, solutions engineers, sub-contractors, and operations resources.
Partner with Strategic Account Managers to define client outcomes, establish win strategy, and shape the overall proposal approach.
Identify and define the full pre-sales resource requirements - people, skills, schedule, and budget needed to compete and win.
Lead client-facing outcome alignment sessions from initial qualification through go-live, ensuring client expectations are clearly defined and documented throughout.
Develop and maintain a detailed pre-sale project plan and pursuit strategy for each active strategic opportunity.

Proposal Development & Scope Ownership

Own the full proposal package for strategic pursuits: project scope of work, exclusions, preliminary project schedule (Gantt), sub-contractor RFQs and quotes, assumptions, and risk log.
Review sales engineering BOMs for completeness, dependencies, and unique site requirements; flag gaps prior to proposal submission.
Draft scope of work exclusions to protect Kastle from post-contract scope creep and change orders.
Ensure all proposal deliverables — drawings, BOMs, assumptions, pricing, and project schedule — are accurate, complete, and aligned with client requirements.
Lead large project reviews with sales and operations leadership on strategic opportunities to confirm scope, pricing model, and approval timeline.
Develop and deliver client presentation strategy for strategic pursuits; present with the account team when required.

Contract-to-Kickoff Transition

Own the contract-to-kickoff handoff- establishing the project channel, populating the project SharePoint folder (BOM, drawings, photos, sub quotes, outcome notes), and conducting a formal kickoff with the regional PM and Sales.
Develop the post-sale PM transition plan and ensure all project management continuity documentation is complete before transferring accountability to operations.
Identify post-sale project management involvement requirements and escalation protocols at proposal stage.

Post-Sale Oversight & Escalation

Co-own the Gantt chart with the regional PM during installation; update weekly and flag schedule risks to the National Account Manager before they reach the client.
Coordinate cross-functional dependencies — elevator vendors, GC schedules, turnstile sub-contractors, tenant provisioning, Kastle operations — to keep strategic projects on track.
Serve as the escalation point when operations encounters design ambiguity or scope questions during installation.

Cross-Functional Coordination

Serve as the connective layer between sales, sales engineering, solutions engineering, integrations, operations, and strategic sub-contractors throughout the pre-sales lifecycle.
Provide feedback to product and engineering teams on client needs, field integration challenges, and recurring proposal gaps.
Support development of client-specific marketing materials and executive-level presentations in partnership with the National Account Manager.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in business, project management, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
7–10+ years of experience in project management, program management, or business development — with demonstrated success managing complex, multi-stakeholder pursuits or deployments.
Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and drive accountability without direct management authority.
Experience managing technically complex projects in the field — particularly systems integration, security, AV, construction, or similar — is strongly preferred.
Familiarity with physical security platforms (access control, CCTV, visitor management) is a plus; deep technical design expertise is not required.
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; comfortable presenting to ownership groups, developers, and executive-level clients.
Strong command of project scheduling tools (MS Project, Smartsheet, or equivalent).
Analytical and problem-solving mindset with strong attention to scope and risk.
PMP certification is a plus, but not required
This position requires approximately 25–30% travel across Kastle regions.

new_jobs.title: IT Security Manager - Customer Trust & Assurance
new_jobs.description:
Wolters Kluwer is seeking an experienced and detail‑oriented Customer Trust & Assurance IT Security Manager
with broad, cross‑domain cybersecurity expertise to join our Customer Trust & Assurance team. In this highly visible role, you will not only serve as a trusted security partner to sales and business development teams, but also provide leadership in shaping how we engage with customers on security, privacy, and compliance. You will help translate our technical posture into clear, credible narratives that build confidence and enable growth.

You will lead the review and response to customer security inquiries—including questionnaires, assessments, and live customer discussions—ensuring responses are accurate, consistent, and aligned with our certifications, policies, and technical documentation. Beyond execution, this role plays a key leadership function in strengthening customer trust, setting standards for quality and consistency, and elevating how security is represented across the organization. You will also bring real‑world customer insights and emerging trends back into the business to help influence internal priorities and continuous improvement.

As a key contributor to our growth strategy, you will drive transparency, thought leadership, and proactive customer engagement, positioning trust and security as strategic differentiators in the market. This is an opportunity to lead at the intersection of security, trust, and business enablement—shaping outcomes, supporting revenue growth, and ensuring alignment with industry best practices.

Responsibilities
:

Customer Trust and Transparency: Scale and build upon existing programs including the customer trust center, providing customers with self-service access to relevant security, privacy and compliance information.
Customer Engagement: Act as a trusted technical and security advisor, engaging customer security teams and IT leaders to align on their cybersecurity & Business needs. Serve as internal subject matter expert on security for the GTM team, supporting sales and account managers in client facing discussions and presentations.
Oversee and guide various internal teams to address customers' security, compliance, and privacy needs. This includes leading the handling of questionnaires, audits, and calls with customers and prospects to ensure their concerns are addressed comprehensively and efficiently.
Industry Thought Leadership: Represent the company externally in security and technology conversations, shaping best practices and positioning our solutions as industry-leading.
Go-to-Market & Sales Acceleration: Bridge the gap between technical value and business outcomes, aligning security messaging with sales and marketing strategies to drive adoption of our products.
Cross-functional Influence & Collaboration: Work closely with the engineering, legal, risk, cyber, and compliance teams to ensure our security responses are accurate and reflect our latest technical and regulatory standing.
Security Documentation: Maintain and update a knowledge base of our security posture, including security policies, certifications (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001), and compliance documentation.
Continuous Improvement: Identify trends in customer security inquiries to help improve our documentation and proactive communication strategies.
Third-Party Risk & Due Diligence: Support third-party risk and due diligence processes, helping customers efficiently evaluate our security posture.
Product Roadmap Contribution: Provide insights on emerging cybersecurity trends and customer expectations to contribute to the product roadmap.
Security Sales Playbook Development: Develop and standardize security sales playbooks, equipping sales teams with messaging, objection handling, and case studies, as applicable.
Attain subject matter expert (SME)-level knowledge of the features and functionalities of Wolters Kluwer products and infrastructure. Lead the education and training of the sales organization on Wolters Kluwer’s security, compliance, and privacy posture, ensuring they are well-equipped to communicate these aspects to customers. Mentor and guide junior team members in developing their expertise.
Lead the review of security clauses in contracts and provide expert advice on Wolters Kluwer’s security, compliance, and privacy measures. Ensure that contracts accurately reflect the company's security posture and compliance with relevant laws and regulations.
Take a leadership role in supporting customer compliance audits by providing necessary documentation, evidence, answering auditor questions, and ensuring that all security, compliance, and privacy measures are thoroughly documented and adhered to. Coordinate with relevant teams to ensure audit readiness.

WHY JOIN US

Meaningful Impact: Play a key role in shaping our customer trust strategy, directly supporting business growth and sales outcomes by demonstrating a strong, credible commitment to security and trust.
Collaborative Environment: Work closely with diverse teams across the organization—from engineering and product to sales and legal—in a fast‑paced, highly collaborative setting.
Thought Leadership: Represent the company externally, contributing to industry conversations and helping shape best practices in security, privacy, and trust.
Customer‑First Mindset: Join a team focused on enabling customers to confidently adopt and expand their use of our solutions through transparency and trust.

Job Qualifications

Bachelors degree in computer science, information security, management information systems or similar.
Experience: At least 10+ years of progressive experience in cybersecurity or information security, with broad, horizontal exposure across multiple security domains. Experience in customer facing roles (minimum 5 years) acting as a trusted advisor to senior security, IT, or business stakeholders.
Technical & Regulatory Expertise: Strong understanding of cybersecurity principles, data protection, privacy, and compliance, including hands on familiarity with areas such as access control, encryption, network security, identity and access management, and incident response.
Strong understanding of major security and regulatory frameworks including NIST CSF, NIST 800 53, SOC 2, ISO 27001, DORA, GDPR, and related risk assessment and internal control methodologies and demonstrated success supporting and leading internal and external audits and certifications.
Communication & Influence: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical and regulatory concepts into clear, concise, and professional messaging for both technical and non technical audiences. Proven ability to influence, collaborate, and build strong relationships with cross functional teams, senior leadership, customers, regulators, and external stakeholders.
Leadership & Collaboration: Demonstrated leadership and people management skills, including the ability to mentor, motivate, and develop team members. Strong cross functional mindset with experience working closely with engineering, legal, compliance, risk, and sales teams.
Analytical & Execution Skills: Highly analytical with strong problem solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to interpret regulatory requirements and assess their impact on business objectives. Proven capability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously, meet deadlines, and drive continuous improvement.
Program & Project Management: Experience leading or contributing to security, compliance, or trust related programs, with solid project and program management skills to plan, prioritize, and execute initiatives effectively.

Preferred Qualification

Experience in developing and implementing scalable Customer Trust Programs
Strong business acumen and the ability to translate complex technical concepts into business value.
Professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, AIGP, AAISM, or equivalent.
Experience with cloud services and cloud technologies (e.g. AWS and Microsoft Azure).

Our Interview Practices

To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.

Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.

Bachelor's degree with 5-10 years of relevant experience

Job Description

Emerging risks shape the future of the insurance industry.

As an Emerging Issues Research Analyst, you’ll play a vital role in helping property/casualty insurers understand that future.

We’re looking for an experienced p/c industry professional with excellent presentation and research skills—someone who understands how the insurance product development, underwriting, and claims process works and can clearly articulate deeply researched, often technical subjects to a professional audience.

The Emerging Issues Research Analyst will help identify emerging risks that would be relevant to a p/c industry audience and then contextualize their impact across lines of p/c insurance. The Analyst must be able to see the big picture—how an issue, trend, technology, legal, or regulatory development might impact or inform product development across multiple lines of p/c business. They must be able to draw on academic research and other rigorous, technical sources of information to better understand and contextualize those impacts. And then they must be capable of stitching this deep research together into a presentation or written report with a clear and compelling narrative to drive more informed decision making.

As a member of Verisk’s Core Lines Services division, the Analyst will also work closely with subject matter experts across the Verisk enterprise to ensure their expertise and views are reflected in the material presented to customers.

The ideal candidate would have a p/c insurance industry background in underwriting, claims, or forms development. They must be an excellent communicator who’s comfortable speaking to audiences in person or virtually, as well as a thorough researcher, and skilled in PowerPoint. They must be a team player, able to quickly establish close working relationships with various internal Verisk stakeholders and external customers.

Responsibilities

Job Description

About The ServiceNow Security Office

The ServiceNow Security Organisation is dedicated to delivering world-class, innovative security solutions that minimise risk and protect both our company and our customers. By enabling the secure migration of sensitive data and workloads to the cloud, we help accelerate ServiceNow's position as the most trusted SaaS provider in the industry.

We are committed to fostering an environment where our employees feel empowered, take pride in their work, and have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact.

About The Team – Global Security Support Centre (GSSC)

The Global Security Support Centre (GSSC) at ServiceNow is a diverse and highly skilled team of security professionals who play a pivotal role in strengthening both our internal and external security posture. The team collaborates closely with various functions across the company and serves as a key interface with our customers on security-related matters.

Through expertise, communication, and a commitment to excellence, the GSSC team reinforces ServiceNow's reputation as a security-first organisation, consistently demonstrating our commitment to protecting our platform, our data, and our customers.

GSSC Mission Statement: To provide external & internal facing security support on behalf of the Security Organisation to improve our customers' security posture and build Customer trust.

Key Responsibilities

Represent security organisation in customer-facing Security Incidents, cases, Security findings, tasks, questions and calls related to Security & Privacy.
Own, triage, investigate and respond to security matters of the ServiceNow platform, ensuring timely communication, resolution and enhanced customer experience and processes.
Act as the primary point of contact for all security-related matters in ServiceNow, supporting both internal and external stakeholders.
Facilitate the efficient workflow/triage of security-related incidents/cases by collaborating with customers and other internal ServiceNow teams.
Build and maintain a high level of customer trust and confidence through exceptional service and communication.
Manage customer outreach communications on Security & escalation handling.
Understand and deliver excellent capability maturity models to fine-tune security processes.
Create and enhance documentation and processes to strengthen security maturity and operational excellence.
Develop and deliver training/enablement programs on Security, for internal and external customers on security awareness and best practices.
Develop AI Solutions for automating repetitive activities & design new solutions leveraging AI.
Work with Legal on security/privacy-related matters & a global team spread across different time zones, so flexibility of times is required.
Provide support and be available as a responsible resource for the On-Call rotation (weekends, public holidays, and after hours) as rostered.

Qualifications

To be successful in this role, you have:

A minimum of 3-5+ years of professional experience in information security or application security roles.

Required Certifications

ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA)

Preferred Certifications (Two Or More)

Azure AI Fundamentals
AWS Certified AI Practitioner
Offensive Security Web Assessor (OSWA)
GIAC Web Application Penetration Tester (GWAPT)

CISSP
CISM

Technical Skills

Solid understanding of cloud computing models and major hyperscaler cloud models.
Hands-on experience with using and understanding security tools and technologies, including: SIEM solutions, logging tools, load balancers, firewalls, WAFs, IDS/IPS, vulnerability management platforms, encryption techniques, etc.
Basic to Intermediate-level programming knowledge in Java/JavaScript with the ability to read, interpret & understand to explain code effectively.
Intermediate to Advanced proficiency in using web proxy tools for security testing and assessments.
Application Security: In-depth understanding of web application vulnerabilities (e.g., OWASP Top Ten) and corresponding mitigation strategies.
Risk Management: Ability to clearly explain security risks to non-technical stakeholders using straightforward, non-technical language.
Compliance & Regulatory Knowledge: Good knowledge of key compliance and regulatory frameworks including: NIST, CIS, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI DSS, ISO standards, etc.
Artificial Intelligence: Experience working with AI technologies and designing AI-based solutions.
Analytical Thinking: Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to evaluate and address complex security challenges.

Soft Skills & Communication

Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to convey technical information to a non-technical audience.
Demonstrated ability to thrive in a team-oriented, collaborative environment, working in a follow-the-sun model.
Good understanding of Security concepts and articulating Security and risk in simple terms without using jargon that makes sense to customers.

Bachelor's degree in computer science or information security or relevant information security experience.
Preferred: Hands-on experience with web-based vulnerability exploitation is a strong plus for success in this role.

Lead and continuously improve core privacy program operations, including privacy impact assessments (DPIAs), records of processing activities (ROPAs), vendor privacy reviews, and privacy compliance workflows, using privacy management tools and workflow automation where appropriate.
Design, implement, and manage scalable processes for data subject rights requests and general privacy inquiries, partnering with Engineering and Support teams to improve efficiency while meeting regulatory deadlines.

Develop and maintain privacy policies, standards, operational guidance, training, records, and self-service resources that enable teams to manage routine privacy obligations independently, with clear escalation paths where appropriate.
Monitor changes in global privacy laws and regulations, translating legal requirements into practical operational processes, controls, and guidance.
Define and report on privacy program metrics, identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, and support initiatives related to incident response, data retention, cross-border data transfers, and broader privacy governance.

Qualifications:

5+ years of experience in privacy, data protection, compliance, or a related program management function.
Demonstrated experience supporting a privacy program subject to the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and one or more U.S. state privacy laws, such as the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), within a multinational or complex organization.
Demonstrated experience translating privacy and data protection requirements, including GDPR and CCPA, into operational processes, policies, controls, guidance, or technical requirements in partnership with Legal, Engineering, Product, and Security teams.
Experience conducting operational privacy activities, including DPIAs, maintaining ROPAs, managing data subject rights requests, vendor privacy reviews, privacy due diligence, and privacy contract reviews.
Experience implementing, administering, or optimizing a privacy management platform (such as OneTrust, TrustArc, or a comparable solution) to support privacy operations, workflow automation, and program governance.
Bachelor's degree (or equivalent practical experience) and a Certified Information Privacy Professional (CIPP), Certified Information Privacy Manager (CIPM), Certified Information Privacy Technologist (CIPT), or equivalent privacy certification.

Experience working in a technology, software-as-a-service (SaaS), or online education environment.
Experience supporting privacy programs for artificial intelligence (AI) or machine learning products.
Experience supporting compliance with additional global privacy laws, including APAC and Latin American privacy frameworks.
Experience defining and reporting operational metrics, KPIs, or dashboards for privacy programs.
Law degree or equivalent legal training.

The HR Risk Operations Project Manager is responsible for leading complex HR risk, compliance, and operational programs from strategy through execution. This role partners closely with People Experience, Legal, Compliance, HRIS, Payroll, Finance, and business stakeholders to translate regulatory requirements, policy priorities, and operational risks into practical programs, standard operating procedures, tools, controls, reporting, and stakeholder guidance. The Manager serves as a consultative resource on employment policy and HR compliance matters, providing clear recommendations, drafting policy-related materials, and supporting consistent, defensible decision-making across the organization.

This role requires strong project and program management discipline, including the ability to develop project plans, manage timelines, coordinate cross-functional workstreams, identify dependencies and risks, and drive deliverables to completion in a fast-paced, matrixed environment. The ideal candidate will bring strong data analytics capabilities, including experience analyzing workforce data, identifying trends and risk indicators, building dashboards or tracking tools, and translating data into executive-ready insights and recommendations.

The HR Risk Operations Project Manager serves as a key member of the People & Culture team in support of firm-wide goals and objectives. This role will report to the Associate Director of HR Risk Operations.

Key responsibilities:

HR Regulatory Program Management

Lead complex HR risk, compliance, and operational programs from planning through execution, including project plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, and deliverables.
Translate legal, regulatory, and business requirements into scalable HR processes, controls, communications, training materials, and stakeholder guidance.
Coordinate cross-functional workstreams by aligning stakeholders, clarifying roles and responsibilities, documenting decisions, and ensuring timely follow-through.
Manage large-scale HR programs supporting multinational firms on the Grant Thornton platform, integrations, and business optimization initiatives.
Support firmwide compliance initiatives, including workforce analysis, Respect in the Workplace training, compliance questionnaires, and other high-priority or confidential projects in partnership with P&C and Legal.
Oversee the firmwide Affirmative Action program, including OFCCP audit response, vendor management, reporting, and program governance.

HR Risk Operations

Partner with Global HR teams to strengthen HR compliance controls and risk frameworks aligned with firm risk appetite.
Ensure HR risk monitoring frameworks remain effective, scalable, and responsive to regulatory changes and business needs.
Develop and maintain standard operating procedures, research summaries, and guidance materials related to HR risk operations and emerging trends.
Lead HR risk management priorities and develop practical short- and long-term solutions for complex business challenges.
Serve as an escalation point for client-related onboarding, background investigation matters, and contract review.
Collaborate with ICS functions, including Finance and Payroll, to improve operational consistency and advance risk management priorities.
Provide day-to-day work direction to global data analytics team members supporting HR risk operations.

Policy Governance

Own the development, implementation, maintenance, and governance of employment policies.
Serve as a policy consultation resource for People Experience, Legal, Compliance, HRIS, Payroll, Finance, and business stakeholders.
Provide practical guidance on employment policy interpretation, process application, and risk mitigation.
Partner with Legal and Compliance to align policies with global requirements and firm standards.
Drive policy harmonization across multinational firms, acquired entities, and evolving business models.
Draft employee-facing policy communications, FAQs, and intranet content to support consistent understanding and application.

Training & Operational Excellence

Monitor emerging labor and employment laws impacting firm policies; translate legal and business changes into practical process improvements and controls.
Develop and manage firmwide HR compliance training programs, including planning, stakeholder coordination, deployment, tracking, and continuous improvement.
Deliver internal training that addresses identified compliance risks, strengthens risk mitigation practices, and promotes a culture of compliance.
Support execution of the P&C strategic plan by advancing operational excellence initiatives aligned with industry standards and business priorities.
Recommend remediation actions, process improvements, and control enhancements based on audit results, monitoring findings, and identified risk trends.
Manage AI-related HR risks by applying firm governance, monitoring regulatory developments, and refining guidelines to support compliant and responsible use.

HR Workforce Analytics, Risk Strategy & Workforce Management

Develop and maintain dashboards, trackers, heat maps, and reporting tools to monitor HR risk, compliance activity, workforce trends, and program effectiveness.
Analyze workforce and operational data to identify trends, emerging risks, control gaps, and opportunities for automation or process improvement.
Prepare executive-ready summaries, insights, recommendations, and status updates to support leadership review and decision-making.
Partner with HRIS, Technology, and analytics teams to improve data quality, reporting processes, automation, and integration of risk operations tools.
Identify and implement automation and reporting enhancements using Power Automate, Power Query, Power BI, and related tools.
Conduct adverse impact analyses as requested and summarize findings for leadership review.
Build automated tracking and reporting tools that integrate multiple data sources, streamline workflows, improve data integrity, and enable real-time reporting.

Health & Safety

Oversee management of health and safety procedures and policies, including infectious disease and workplace violence safety programs
Monitor ongoing regulatory updates including OSHA standards, injury and illness prevention programs and government contractor compliance
Assist with real-time response during crisis matters such as natural disasters, including drafting employee-facing communications and compiling resources for impacted employees

The ideal candidate will be:

A business‑minded HR Risk &Compliance professional who excels at statistical workplace analysis, internal/external HR compliance, project and process management with impeccable planning, coordination, and follow‑through.
Operationally rigorous, detail‑accurate, and deadline‑reliable in a fast‑moving, matrixed environment.
Analytical, comfortable with metrics and translating data into clear executive summaries , timelines, and stakeholder guidance.
A concise, audience‑aware communicator who can write, edit, and sequence communications that drive clarity and action.
A strong collaborator across Legal/Compliance, People & Culture, Technology/HRIS, People Experience and Inclusion teams; adept at role clarity and RACI management.
Comfortable and integrity driven professional with experience in handling highly confidential information, sound judgment, and executive‑facing professionalism.

The Ideal Candidate Will Possess:

6–8 years of progressive experience in HR Compliance, HR program management, PMO/operations, or organizational effectiveness (professional services experience a plus).
Hands‑on experience building and managing complex program plans (e.g., Smartsheet), SOPs, process documentation, and trainings.
Advanced data and reporting skills (Excel/Power BI or similar) Experience with Power Queries, look-ups, pivot tables and experience supporting various systems
Proficiency with MS Office, SharePoint/Teams, and content maintenance on intranet site.
Strong written and verbal communication; experience drafting broad‑reach communications, policies, FAQs, research papers and leader talking points and briefings.
HR regulatory reporting experience

new_jobs.title: Pricing and Business Intelligence Analyst
new_jobs.description:
The 
Pricing and Business Intelligence Analyst
will be responsible for analyzing business and market data to assist with maximizing profits and sales, creating clear reports and dashboards for business leaders, tracking market trends including global economic factors and market risks, and helping to identify and implement strategic solutions to optimize the team’s processes. This role will drive transformational changes to enhance pricing strategies, understand market risks, identify and implement process improvements to include the utilization of pricing software and drive margin growth. This position offers the opportunity to work in a dynamic and challenging environment, collaborate with global cross-functional teams, and contribute to the success of our organization. *This position can be based in other Force and Motion Group business offices (Brecksville, OH or Maumee, OH).* If you are a self-motivated, career-minded individual seeking an exciting growth opportunity, please submit your name for further consideration.

Key Responsibilities

Analyze business and market data.

Create clear reports and Power BI dashboards 

Identify areas for improvement, implement strategic solutions, and drive transformational change to enhance pricing strategies, efficiency, and margin.

Analyze current pricing and business processes, identifying inefficiencies, trends, and areas for improvement.

Assist with the identification and implementation of pricing software to improve processes, identify leakage, drive margin management, and provide ease of doing business for our customers.

Develop recommendations aligned with global category strategies to optimize profitability and competitiveness.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather insights, align objectives, and implement best practices.

Develop and manage measurement systems to track project progress.

Conduct in-depth profitability analysis by region, market, and product category to identify trends and opportunities for margin improvements. 

Monitor global commodity fluctuations and assess their impact on pricing strategies, making recommendations for adjustments as needed. 

Drive continuous improvement initiatives within pricing processes, leveraging data analytics to enhance efficiency and effectiveness. 

Provide regular updates and reports to senior management on project status, risks, and opportunities.

Perform additional duties as assigned to support global pricing strategies and business growth. 

Uphold the company Code of Ethics and Values in all activities.

Skills & Qualifications:

5+ years in business or pricing analysis, process engineering, or other relevant business positions within an industrial B2B environment, with international business history preferred. 

Strong ability to analyze processes and data to make strategic recommendations. 

Proficiency in understanding data, data modeling, profiling, and validation

Expertise in data mining, analysis, reporting and visualization tools.

Ability to use financial modeling to create forecasts

Experience successfully managing multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.

Proficient in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Access, PowerPoint) and Power BI with the ability to learn and adapt to new software. Experience with Salesforce, Infor M3 and JBA is preferred. 

Understanding of how AI can be used to provide benefit in the role.

Strong understanding of pricing methodologies, best practices, and industry standards

Ability to work independently, manage multiple projects, and maintain a detail-oriented, structured approach to achieving planned outcomes. 

Critical thinking and problem-solving abilities

Awareness of technology advancements and willingness to learn new tools and processes.

Solid verbal/written communication skills.

Ability to multi-task, prioritize and manage time effectively.

Education:

Bachelor’s degree in business, Statistics, Analytics, Computer Science, Data Science or a related field.

Advanced degree and/or certification preferred. 

Core FMG Competencies:

Instill Trust

Business Insight 

Collaborates

Communicates Effectively

Drives results

Physical Demands: 

The characteristics listed below are representative of the physical demands required by an individual to successfully perform the essential duties of this position. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential duties.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand, walk, and sit; use hands and fingers to handle paperwork, boxes, files, cabinets, or feel; and reach with hands and arms.

The employee is frequently required to talk and/or hear.

Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee has exposure to a normal office environment.

A division of Publicis Groupe, Publicis Digital Experience is a network of top-tier agencies designed to develop capabilities and solutions to enable growth and provide scaled access to the digital capabilities of Publicis Groupe in service of our clients. With our unique expertise in consumer engagement, CRM, and commerce, Publicis Digital Experience powers brands and empowers people in a new era of creativity. An ever-changing landscape and the need for fluid thinking is just part of our problem-solving nature. Which means we're untethered from any specific medium or method—we go where ideas will work best.

We are an expanding network with more than 5,000 employees, with agency brands throughout our global offices. Publicis Digital Experience brands include Razorfish, Digitas, Arc Worldwide, Saatchi Saatchi X, Plowshare, 3Share, Epsilon Auto and the Publicis Commerce Exchange.

Overview

Experience with digital marketing analytics tools such as Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, and Google Ads
